title: CogCoM: A Visual Language Model with Chain-of-Manipulations Reasoning
authors_zh: Ji Qi, Ming Ding, Weihan Wang, Yushi Bai, Qingsong Lv, Wenyi Hong, Bin Xu, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
paper_type_zh: 视觉操作链数据集与多模态模型报告
best_for_zh: 适合构建或审计视觉定位、OCR、计算与图形推理示范数据的读者。
one_line: CogCoM releases visual manipulation chains whose grounding, OCR, and calculation results form evidence-bearing multimodal SFT targets.
CogCoM 公开由 GPT-4 规划、视觉工具执行并以金答案终止筛选的视觉操作链，用作带证据的多模态 SFT 目标。
why: It exposes a structured bridge from visual tools and golden answers to trainable multi-turn reasoning demonstrations.
inclusion_reason: CoMDataset publishes step-level visual manipulation demonstrations with explicit trace authors, executable visual annotations, answer-terminating DFS selection, and direct SFT consumption.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Visual-language models trained only on image-question-answer triples can match the final answer while hiding whether they localized the right object, read the right text, or performed the right calculation. This conclusion-aligned supervision is especially weak for small objects, OCR, counting, geometry, and charts, where an auditable intermediate visual operation matters.

CogCoM turns those intermediate operations into released demonstrations: GPT-4 proposes manipulation-assisted steps, GroundingDINO and PaddleOCR instantiate visual evidence, depth-first search keeps chains that terminate at the golden answer, and experts add graphical-math chains. The resulting record is a visual question plus structured manipulation findings and a final chain consumed by multimodal SFT.

L4 facts: Primary source: arXiv:2402.04236 and the ICLR 2025 final paper; venue/date: ICLR 2025, official OpenReview record; decision boundary: released evidence-bearing visual rationale records rather than a tool-only inference scaffold or model weights alone; atlas object/evaluation: image, question, answer, manipulation nodes, boxes/text/calculations, and final chain, evaluated by VQA, grounding, math, hallucination, and chain metrics; collection note: L4_carded, one Track 01 category.

# 问题

只用图像、问题和最终答案训练的视觉语言模型，即使答案匹配，也不会暴露它是否定位了正确对象、读到了正确文字或进行了正确计算。对于小物体、OCR、计数、几何和图表任务，这种只对齐结论的监督尤其薄弱，因为可审计的中间视觉操作本身很重要。

CogCoM 把中间操作变成公开示范：GPT-4 提出带操作的求解步骤，GroundingDINO 和 PaddleOCR 实例化视觉证据，深度优先搜索保留以金答案终止的链，专家再补充图形数学链。最终记录由视觉问题、结构化操作发现和供多模态 SFT 使用的完整操作链组成。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2402.04236 和 ICLR 2025 最终论文；正式来源为 ICLR 2025 官方 OpenReview 记录；判定边界是公开的带视觉证据推理记录，而不是仅有工具推理框架或模型权重；图谱对象与评测面包括图像、问题、答案、操作节点、框/文本/计算和最终链，并以问答、定位、数学、幻觉与链指标评估；收录状态为 L4_carded，仅归入一个 Track 01 类别。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
# Core idea

CogCoM defines a chain of manipulations as linguistic reasoning interleaved with explicit operations such as OCR, Grounding, CropZoomIn, Counting, Calculate, and Line. A plan becomes a branching execution tree; visual models or experts fill its results, and final-answer-terminating paths become multi-turn, multi-image SFT targets. The primary category is instruction, demonstration, and rationale data because the released chain, not the runtime tool environment, is the training consumer's serialized object.

Google Scholar citations: 40（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=CogCoM%3A+A+Visual+Language+Model+with+Chain-of-Manipulations+Reasoning&author=Ji+Qi&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: CoMDataset Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/qijimrc/CoMDataset Scale: 80,827 released automatic records, 4,518 test records, and 6,998 expert math records; the paper summarizes the training portions as about 70K automatic and 7K math chains Record form: pid, image_path, decoded_image, question, answer, com_founds, and final_com; manipulation findings include operation, arguments, boxes or recognized text, variables, return values, descriptions, and found status File / storage format: public Parquet/JSONL data plus an image archive and visualization notebook Domains / languages: primarily English visual question answering, OCR, counting, visual grounding, charts, geometry, and graphical mathematics Construction and filtering: GPT-4-turbo writes plans, GroundingDINO/PaddleOCR execute primitive operations, DFS keeps paths ending in the source answer, and ten experts author and verify the math subset License / access constraints: CC-BY-SA-4.0 for the official release; component benchmark images and questions retain their source terms Intended use: evidence-bearing multimodal SFT, visual-tool distillation, manipulation-trace auditing, and controlled studies of intermediate visual supervision

# 核心思想

CogCoM 把操作链定义为自然语言推理与显式操作的交错序列，操作包括 OCR、定位、裁剪放大、计数、计算和画线。一个计划会展开为分支执行树，由视觉模型或专家填入结果，再把以最终答案终止的路径转换为多轮、多图像 SFT 目标。主分类是指令、示范与推理数据，因为公开的链才是训练消费者使用的序列化对象，而不是运行时工具环境。

Google Scholar 引用数：40（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=CogCoM%3A+A+Visual+Language+Model+with+Chain-of-Manipulations+Reasoning&author=Ji+Qi&hl=en）

开放数据集：是 数据集名称：CoMDataset 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/qijimrc/CoMDataset 规模：公开版本包含 80,827 条自动记录、4,518 条测试记录和 6,998 条专家数学记录；论文把训练部分概述为约 7 万条自动链和 7 千条数学链 记录形式：字段包括 pid、image_path、decoded_image、question、answer、com_founds 与 final_com；操作发现还记录操作、参数、框或识别文本、变量、返回值、描述和命中状态 文件与存储格式：公开的 Parquet/JSONL 数据、图像压缩包和可视化笔记本 领域与语言：以英文视觉问答、OCR、计数、视觉定位、图表、几何和图形数学为主 构造与筛选：GPT-4-turbo 编写计划，GroundingDINO/PaddleOCR 执行原子操作，深度优先搜索保留以源答案结束的路径，十位专家编写并核验数学子集 许可与访问约束：官方发布使用 CC-BY-SA-4.0；组件基准的图像和问题仍受各自来源条款约束 预期用途：带证据的多模态 SFT、视觉工具蒸馏、操作轨迹审计和中间视觉监督的受控研究

title: Method
方法
html:
# Method

Step 1 - Select source tasks and define operations. Input: Image-question-answer triples from TextVQA, ST-VQA, and TDIUC, plus graphical math tasks from MathVista and ChartQA. Operation: Define OCR, Grounding, CropZoomIn, Counting, Calculate, and Line as atomic manipulations and retain the source golden answer as the terminal target. Output and transition: Each source item becomes an image, question, answer, and manipulation vocabulary ready for planning. Check / stop rule: Exclude tasks without a stable answer or an operation/evidence path that can be represented in the CoM schema.

Step 2 - Generate linguistic plans. Input: The question, manipulation definitions, five manually written demonstrations, the output schema, and GPT-4-turbo. Operation: Ask the language annotator to write stepwise manipulation calls and descriptions while leaving tool results as variables. Output and transition: A symbolic sequence of operations and dependencies becomes the skeleton of an execution tree. Check / stop rule: Every step must name an operation, parameters or referenced variables, and a result slot; malformed plans do not proceed to visual execution.

Step 3 - Execute visual operations and search paths. Input: The image, symbolic plan, GroundingDINO, PaddleOCR, and local implementations of derived crop, count, and calculation operations. Operation: Instantiate possible boxes, text, images, or numbers, branch on alternative results, and traverse the resulting tree with depth-first search. Output and transition: Positive paths preserve concrete visual returns and end at the source golden answer; negative branches are omitted from the released training chain. Check / stop rule: Keep only paths whose final manipulation returns the golden answer; separately audit overly large boxes because answer agreement does not prove every intermediate result.

Step 4 - Add expert math and serialize training targets. Input: MathVista/ChartQA items, ten experts, automatic positive paths, and the multi-turn VQA adapter. Operation: Experts write both reasoning and manipulation results for math items; all chains are segmented around derived images into multi-turn image-question-response demonstrations. Output and transition: About 70K automatic and 7K expert math chains become trainable multi-turn, multi-image records; the current release exposes 80,827/6,998 records plus 4,518 test items. Check / stop rule: Verify expert results, cap image turns for memory limits, and preserve source/split identity so test chains are not consumed as training data.

Step 5 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The CoM records, other VQA/grounding/chat mixtures, and a CogVLM-style 17B model. Operation: Apply staged next-token training, retaining KV memory across turns so later text can condition on earlier images and manipulation outputs; evaluate VQA, grounding, math, hallucination, and CoM-test chain quality. Output and transition: CogCoM checkpoints and controlled with/without-CoM comparisons test whether the released traces add value. Check / stop rule: Hold non-CoM data, backbone, and training settings fixed for the data ablation; report token/time overhead and do not treat final-answer accuracy as step-level faithfulness.

Reproducibility: verify the ICLR/arXiv paper, official repository, CC-BY-SA-4.0 dataset revision, image archive, and actual Parquet/JSONL schema. Pin source benchmark versions, five demonstrations, GPT-4 snapshot, visual-model checkpoints, manipulation code, DFS rule, answer normalization, split mapping, turn cap, and training mixture. API tokens/cost, complete failed branches, semantic decontamination, component-rights reconciliation, and independent step-accuracy statistics are not fully disclosed.

# 方法

  1. 选择源任务并定义操作。输入是 TextVQA、ST-VQA 和 TDIUC 的图像问答三元组，以及 MathVista、ChartQA 的图形数学题。流程定义 OCR、定位、裁剪放大、计数、计算和画线六类原子操作，并保留源金答案作为终止目标。若任务没有稳定答案或无法用操作与证据路径表示，则停止。
  2. 生成语言计划。把问题、操作定义、五个手写示范和输出格式交给 GPT-4-turbo，使其编写逐步操作调用与描述，并把工具结果保留为变量。每一步必须包含操作名、参数或变量引用和结果槽，格式错误的计划不进入视觉执行。
  3. 执行视觉操作并搜索路径。GroundingDINO、PaddleOCR 和本地裁剪、计数、计算实现会填入框、文本、图像或数值，并对多种结果形成分支树，再用深度优先搜索寻找路径。只保留最后一个操作返回金答案的路径；对于过大的定位框仍需单独审计，因为答案一致不证明每个中间结果正确。
  4. 加入专家数学链并序列化。十位专家为 MathVista 和 ChartQA 编写推理步骤与操作结果；所有链按派生图像切分为多轮、多图像问答示范。论文约有 7 万条自动链和 7 千条专家数学链，当前发布分别提供 80,827、6,998 条记录及 4,518 条测试记录。需要核验专家结果、限制图像轮数，并保留来源和划分身份。
  5. 训练并评估消费者。将操作链与其他问答、定位和对话数据混合，对 CogVLM 风格的 17B 模型进行分阶段次词训练，并在轮次间保留键值记忆。评测覆盖问答、定位、数学、幻觉和操作链质量；数据消融必须固定非操作链数据、骨干和训练设置，也不能把最终答案准确率当作逐步忠实度。

可复现性：应核验 ICLR/arXiv 论文、官方代码库、CC-BY-SA-4.0 数据版本、图像包和真实 Parquet/JSONL 字段。需要固定源基准版本、五个示范、GPT-4 快照、视觉模型检查点、操作代码、搜索规则、答案归一化、划分映射、轮数上限和训练混合。API token 与成本、完整失败分支、语义去污染、组件权利协调和独立逐步准确率均未完整披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
# Evidence

Controlled data ablation. CogCoM-chat is trained with and without the 70K automatically generated CoM records while other settings are kept unchanged. Adding CoM changes TextVQA from 64.5 to 71.1, MM-Vet from 45.9 to 46.1, and MathVista from 34.8 to 35.7. This is the strongest evidence that the released trace data contributes beyond the shared mixture, although the gains vary sharply by task and the comparison does not separate planning text from visual-operation returns.

Construction-quality boundary. The automatic pipeline finds a golden-answer-terminating path for 35.55% of planned items and discards other branches. The paper reports manual inspection found most retained paths correct, but gives no independent step-level error rate; small or uncommon objects have lower construction success, and an overly large grounding box can still produce a coincidentally correct final answer.

# 证据

受控数据消融。CogCoM-chat 在其他设置不变时，分别加入或移除 7 万条自动生成的操作链记录。加入数据后，TextVQA 从 64.5 提升到 71.1，MM-Vet 从 45.9 提升到 46.1，MathVista 从 34.8 提升到 35.7。这是公开轨迹数据在共享混合之外产生贡献的最强证据，但不同任务增益差异很大，实验也没有把计划文字与视觉操作返回值的作用分开。

构造质量边界。自动流程在 35.55% 的规划样本上找到以金答案结束的路径，其余分支被丢弃。论文称人工检查发现大部分保留路径正确，但没有给出独立的逐步错误率；小型或少见对象的构造成功率更低，过大的定位框也可能偶然得到正确最终答案。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
# Novelty

Earlier visual CoT data usually supplied free-form explanations, while visual-program systems executed tools at inference without turning their evidence into a compatible end-to-end training record. CogCoM changes the supervision object: each reasoning step names a visual manipulation, carries its concrete return, participates in an answer-terminating execution path, and is serialized into multi-turn VQA. The direction signal is this auditable bridge from LLM planning and visual-tool execution to reusable multimodal demonstrations, plus a matched data ablation. OCR, grounding, program decomposition, golden-answer filtering, and multi-turn VLM training are not individually new, and the paper does not prove that its six-operation vocabulary is complete.

# 新意

较早的视觉思维链数据通常只提供自由文本解释，而视觉程序系统多在推理时执行工具，却没有把证据转成兼容端到端训练的记录。CogCoM 改变了监督对象：每个推理步骤都命名视觉操作、携带具体返回值、参与一条以答案终止的执行路径，并被序列化成多轮问答。方向信号在于把语言模型规划和视觉工具执行连接到可复用、可审计的多模态示范，并提供匹配的数据消融。OCR、定位、程序分解、金答案筛选和多轮视觉模型训练各自都不是新概念，论文也没有证明六种操作覆盖所有任务。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
# Limitations

  • Curator audit risk: final-answer-terminating DFS is an outcome check, not a proof that every box, OCR string, calculation, or explanation is faithful. Re-execute available operations and manually inspect intermediate results, especially large boxes and coincidental answer matches.
  • Curator audit risk: only positive paths are released for training, hiding failed branches and making tool failure, selection bias, and the reported 35.55% construction success hard to reproduce. Preserve generation denominators and negative branches in any new build.
  • Curator audit risk: the release license is CC-BY-SA-4.0, but source benchmark images/questions retain their own rights and no full semantic decontamination table is reported. Build a component license ledger and compare image/question hashes and semantics with every evaluation split.

# 局限

  • 整理审计风险：以金答案终止的深度优先搜索只是结果检查，并不能证明每个框、OCR 文本、计算或解释都忠实。复用时应重放可执行操作并人工检查中间结果，尤其关注过大定位框和偶然答案匹配。
  • 整理审计风险：训练发布只保留正路径，失败分支被隐藏，使工具故障、选择偏差和 35.55% 构造成功率难以复现。新的构建应保留生成分母与负分支。
  • 整理审计风险：发布许可为 CC-BY-SA-4.0，但源基准图像与问题仍有各自权利，论文也没有完整语义去污染表。应建立组件级许可台账，并将图像、问题的哈希与语义同所有评测划分比较。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
# Usefulness

  • Multimodal data builder: reuse the plan-execute-search-serialize recipe to turn image QA into demonstrations with explicit boxes, text, derived images, and calculations. Success requires gains over answer-only data under matched examples, tokens, backbone, and training settings.
  • Trace auditor: stratify released records by source, operation, object size, and automatic versus expert authorship; replay operations where possible and report step accuracy, golden-answer coincidence, fallback, and unexecutable-call rates.
  • Do not use when: source-image rights cannot be reconciled, the task lacks stable answer normalization, or visual operations cannot be independently replayed; then neither redistribution nor the claimed evidence chain can be defended.

# 用途

  • 多模态数据构建：复用“规划、执行、搜索、序列化”流程，把图像问答转成显式包含框、文本、派生图像和计算的示范。成功标准是在样本数、token、骨干和训练设置匹配时优于只含答案的数据。
  • 轨迹审计：按来源、操作、对象大小以及自动或专家作者分层抽样；在可能时重放操作，并报告逐步准确率、偶然答案匹配率、回退率和不可执行调用率。
  • 不应使用的情形：无法协调源图像权利、任务没有稳定答案归一化方式，或视觉操作无法独立重放；这些情况下既无法为再分发辩护，也无法验证所谓证据链。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
# Reading notes

  • Positioning: CogCoM replaces answer-only visual supervision with released manipulation chains whose intermediate visual results can be inspected.
  • Method handle: GPT-4 plans, GroundingDINO/PaddleOCR execute, DFS selects golden-answer paths, experts write math chains, and an adapter converts them to multi-turn VQA.
  • Data/artifact handle: the CC-BY-SA-4.0 release exposes 80,827 automatic, 4,518 test, and 6,998 math records with com_founds and final_com fields plus images.
  • Evidence anchor: adding 70K CoM records under the paper's matched ablation changes TextVQA 64.5 to 71.1, MM-Vet 45.9 to 46.1, and MathVista 34.8 to 35.7.
  • Reuse decision: use for evidence-bearing visual SFT only after replaying steps, preserving failures/denominators, reconciling component rights, and checking train-test overlap.

# 阅读笔记

  • 定位：CogCoM 用公开的视觉操作链替代仅含答案的视觉监督，中间视觉结果可以被检查。
  • 方法抓手：GPT-4 规划，GroundingDINO/PaddleOCR 执行，深度优先搜索选择金答案路径，专家编写数学链，再用适配器转为多轮问答。
  • 数据与产物：CC-BY-SA-4.0 发布含 80,827 条自动记录、4,518 条测试记录和 6,998 条数学记录，字段包含 com_founds、final_com 及图像。
  • 证据锚点：论文的匹配消融加入 7 万条操作链后，TextVQA 从 64.5 变为 71.1，MM-Vet 从 45.9 变为 46.1，MathVista 从 34.8 变为 35.7。
  • 复用决定：仅在重放步骤、保留失败与生成分母、协调组件权利并检查训练评测重叠后，用于带证据的视觉 SFT。

value.html: GroundingDINO and PaddleOCR supply visual evidence; DFS retains paths whose last manipulation reaches the golden answer, while expert annotators construct and check the math subset.

value_zh.html: GroundingDINO 与 PaddleOCR 提供视觉证据；DFS 保留最后一次操作达到标准答案的路径，而专家标注者构造并检查数学子集。

value.html: A positive automated path must terminate at the source golden answer; failed tool-result branches are excluded from the final chain.

value_zh.html: 正例自动路径必须终止于来源标准答案；失败的工具结果分支被排除出最终链。

value.html: CogVLM-style 17B model with EVA2-CLIP-E visual encoder, Vicuna-7B-v1.5 backbone, MLP adapter, and 6.5B visual-expert parameters.

value_zh.html: CogVLM 风格的 17B 模型，含 EVA2-CLIP-E 视觉编码器、Vicuna-7B-v1.5 骨干、MLP 适配器与 6.5B 视觉专家参数。

value.html: GPT-4-turbo is the linguistic annotator; GroundingDINO and PaddleOCR are visual annotators; ten experts annotate CoM-Math.

value_zh.html: GPT-4-turbo 为语言标注器；GroundingDINO 与 PaddleOCR 为视觉标注器；十位专家标注 CoM-Math。

value.html: Prompt GPT-4 with six manipulation definitions and five demonstrations, execute grounding/OCR-derived operations, and traverse the result tree.

value_zh.html: 用六个操作定义与五个示范提示 GPT-4，执行锚定/OCR 导出的操作，并遍历结果树。

value.html: Produce about 70K automated chains and 7K expert math samples; the release exposes 80,827 automatic records, 4,518 test records, and 6,998 math records.

value_zh.html: 产生约 70K 条自动链与 7K 个专家数学样本；发布暴露 80,827 条自动记录、4,518 条测试记录与 6,998 条数学记录。

value.html: Depth-first search keeps only branches ending in the golden answer; expert math records preserve manually supplied manipulation results.

value_zh.html: 深度优先搜索仅保留终止于标准答案的分支；专家数学记录保留人工提供的操作结果。

value.html: GPT-4-turbo annotation ran from September to December 2023; the paper reports a 0.3555 positive-path success rate but not total API tokens or cost.

value_zh.html: GPT-4-turbo 标注于 2023 年 9 月至 12 月进行；论文报告 0.3555 的正例路径成功率，但未报告总 API tokens 或成本。

value.html: Three next-token stages; the final 576K-image stage uses batch 160, 14K iterations, AdamW, learning rate 1e-5, and 160 A100-days.

value_zh.html: 三个 next-token 阶段；最终 576K 图像阶段使用 batch 160、14K 次迭代、AdamW、学习率 1e-5 与 160 个 A100-天。

value.html: Released splits contain 80,827 automated records, 4,518 CoM-test records, and 6,998 CoM-Math records; paper Table 5 reports 13,766 TextVQA, 3,959 ST-VQA, 54,523 TDIUC-count, and 11,677 TDIUC-absurd chains.

value_zh.html: 已发布划分含 80,827 条自动记录、4,518 条 CoM-test 记录与 6,998 条 CoM-Math 记录；论文表 5 报告 13,766 条 TextVQA、3,959 条 ST-VQA、54,523 条 TDIUC-count 与 11,677 条 TDIUC-absurd 链。

value.html: The official release separates com, com_test, and com_math Parquet/JSONL files; source benchmark leakage beyond those declared splits is not quantified.

value_zh.html: 官方发布将 com、com_test 与 com_math Parquet/JSONL 文件分开；超出这些已声明划分的源基准泄漏未量化。

value.html: No semantic image/question decontamination report is provided across training mixtures and all nine downstream benchmarks.

value_zh.html: 未提供跨训练混合物与全部九个下游基准的语义图像/问题去污染报告。

items: Five-shot GPT-4 prompting produces low-diversity manipulation language and can overfit a narrow trace style.
Grounding/OCR errors create wrong branches, while final-answer agreement cannot prove every retained intermediate statement is faithful.
The model internalizes tool outputs and does not execute external tools at inference, so emitted boxes/text can still be hallucinated.
五样本 GPT-4 提示产生低多样性操作语言，并可能过拟合狭窄的 trace 风格。
锚定/OCR 错误会产生错误分支，而最终答案一致不能证明每条保留的中间陈述都忠实。
模型内化工具输出，推理时不执行外部工具，因此发出的框/文本仍可能是幻觉。

value.html: The official Hugging Face dataset identifies CC-BY-SA-4.0; component images and source VQA datasets retain their own terms.

value_zh.html: 官方 Hugging Face 数据集标明 CC-BY-SA-4.0；组件图像与源 VQA 数据集保留其自身条款。

value.html: Public VQA triples receive GPT-4 plans, executable visual annotations, DFS answer filtering, and multi-turn serialization; expert math chains are added separately before SFT.

value_zh.html: 公开 VQA 三元组接受 GPT-4 计划、可执行视觉标注、DFS 答案过滤与多轮序列化；专家数学链在 SFT 前另行加入。
